sanitizerGate.rule: After V has merged, every merge also runs the sanitize ctest on the merged tree. A report not in the baseline fails the merge.

packages.title: Seams for parallel work
exit: Build, ctest, plan check and op check give the same results as before the change
CMakeLists.txt includes every module.cmake under src/ at any depth (GLOB_RECURSE, sorted), so nested modules such as src/preview/transitions/ register without a shared edit
A test package that adds a module in a nested folder (src/<module>/<name>/module.cmake), CLI mode, edit, panel and menu item touches no shared file (git diff --stat), and its test runs in ctest

ServerClient::upload(json, filePath, contentType) sends the multipart POST /api/assets of AssetStore.ts through the same private write path as mutate: an upload of a media fixture to the scratch server returns the asset and assets.get returns it
With an expected instance and a listener whose /ready answer lacks it, upload sends no multipart body (tst_serverclient)

packages.title: Core seams, round 2
exit: Build, ctest, the plan check (with and without --examples), the op check and check-mix.mjs give the same results as before. --dump-plan output is byte-identical on every fixture while no hook is registered
The sanitize and tsan ctest runs report nothing outside tools/sanitizers/baseline.md (Mixer and AudioEngine are threaded units)

Layer-source registry (I): a factory registered for a layer kind replaces SyntheticSource in PreviewCompositorRenderer::entryFor; tst_layerhooks draws a registered solid-colour source in an offscreen still. Red: the same test against the old entryFor shows the synthetic pattern

Layer decorators (D3, D5, I, J): a registered decorator gets each ActiveLayer with its Clip and time, may set ActiveLayer.ext and ActiveLayer.sourceRect, and framePlanJson writes ext when it is not empty (tst_layerhooks)

Source UV rectangle (D5): composite.vert and composite.frag sample through sourceRect, full by default; a decorator that sets the left half gives a still equal to the cropped reference (tst_layerhooks)

Effect stages (J): a registered stage runs on a layer texture and on a group surface before compositing, with the layer's ext parameters; an invert stage registered by tst_layerhooks inverts that layer's pixels in the still and leaves the others

Text measurer (I): a measurer registered for the scene is passed to the flex layout in evaluateScene; tst_layerhooks shows a changed flex box with a fixed-width measurer and the fallback rule without one
Source-time mapper (D3): clipSourceMsAt consults a registered mapper and keeps its formula without one (tst_layerhooks)

Mixer voice expander (D3) and gain envelope (P2) in src/audio/hooks/: a registered expander splits a voice into segments, a silent segment writes zeros, an envelope scales the gain; without hooks tst_mixer and check-mix.mjs are unchanged (tst_mixerhooks)

Output device selector (R): AudioEngine asks a registered provider for a device name before ma_device_init and falls back to the default device when no playback device matches; tst_mixerhooks covers the pick on miniaudio's null backend

Decode-mode default (R): main.cpp uses a provider registered in src/app/startup/ when neither --decode nor --decoder is set, and the help text names it; tst_startuphooks checks flag, provider and the sw fallback

TimelineModel media registration (B F1): registerMedia adds the runtime paths of new media without a history reset or a generation change; tst_modelhooks drops a clip with new media, registers it, and the preview resolves the path with the undo count unchanged

TimelineModel settlement (B F2): applyEdit and commitEdit return a command token, and settleCommand(token, document) replaces that command's result; undo then redo after a settlement gives the settled document, and a settlement after an undo changes only the command (tst_modelhooks)

Plan comparators (D5, I, J): scripts/plan-conformance.mjs loads extra comparators from scripts/conformance/plan/*.mjs; a planted comparator that rejects every layer fails the check once, and the plant is removed

packages.title: UI wiring, round 2
exit: Every in-app criterion has a test that loads the production QML (TimelineEditor.qml with a fixture document, offscreen) and drives it by pointer or keyboard; tests that call a command directly do not count

C: the visible, lock, mute and solo header buttons toggle their field, delete asks to confirm as the menu does, a grip drag reorders tracks of the same type with a 2 px drop line, and a 6 px separator resizes a track (48 to 300 px, divided by vertical zoom, ArrowUp/Down 8 or 32 px), each one undo entry (closes B9, B10, B11)

M: the target chip toggles targeting and dims when off, the sync button toggles sync lock and shows SyncDisabled in the warning tone, and liftRange, extractRange, rippleTrimPrevToPlayhead, rippleTrimNextToPlayhead, cutAllTracks and splitAtPlayhead with an empty selection follow TracksRegion.tsx (closes B22, B27, B28)

F: copy, cut, paste, pasteInsert, pasteAttributes (opens PasteAttributesDialog), duplicate, duplicateWithGap, groupClips and ungroupClips keys, Alt-drag copy, marquee selection with RubberBandOverlay, gap selection with Delete closing the gap, and GroupBracket on group clips; paste reads the targeted tracks and the drop mode (closes B19, B26)
K: shuttleBack, shuttleStop, shuttleForward, toggleLoop, playInToOut, stepFrameBack, stepFrameForward, and the in and out marks drive the PlaybackClock range (closes B14, B34)
D1: the clip keyframe diamonds are mounted in ClipBody, and a drag retimes and a click seeks (closes B12)
D4: the transition wedge has a length grip labelled Transition length, one undo entry per drag (closes B33), and TransitionHandle caps growth at the probed source length (closes B29)
The shortcut sheet marks each newly wired action as available
InspectorSliderRow lays its slider out at a non-zero height, a pointer drag changes the value, and the QEXPECT_FAIL in tst_transitions.cpp is removed (closes B21)
Panel slots accept any name matching [a-z][A-Za-z0-9]* in registerPanel and in the nt-panel marker, and a refused registration logs a warning
Slot clipBody: an item registered there is created on every clip body with clip, timeline, gestures and viewState (D2 fade grips)
Slot toolbar: items registered there appear after Snap in ToolToggle (N Bars toggle and grid select)
Slot documentBar: actions registered there appear after Undo and Redo (A project settings)
Slot preview: items registered there sit inside the preview frame and are clipped to it; the transform gizmo moves there and takes no click outside the frame (closes B18; D5 focus overlay)
Slot trackLane: rows registered there appear under each track lane (P2 automation lanes)

Context menus: a right-click on a clip, a track header, an empty lane or the ruler opens the MenuRegistry items of that kind, and an item runs ClipGestureController::runAction, the same handler as its shortcut (G)
Key actions: an action registered in src/wiring/ runs when handleKey does not handle its key, and availableActions lists it (O source keys, D2 audioGain, D3 speedDuration, Q workspaces)
Snap candidates: providers registered in src/wiring/ add candidates in collectSnapCandidates while snapping applies (N beat lines)
Ruler: TimelineViewState has rulerMode (time or bars) and gridDivision (beat by default), and TimeRuler and RulerCanvas draw ticks from a provider registered for the mode, time by default (N)
Each slot and registry has a test that registers a test item and finds it in the running editor, and each fails once against the unwired files
Build, ctest, the plan check and the op check pass; tst_tracksregion, tst_tracksui, tst_transitions (with the expected failure removed) and the D1 QML tests pass

registerEdit and overrideEdit record each refused name with a warning; nodetool-timeline --check-edit-registry lists every name with its registrar and exits 1 on a refusal; ctest runs it on the app binary. Red: on the old registrars it reports the four duplicates

In the app's registration set, ripple delete, both ripple trims and close gap on V1 leave a sync-lock-off track A2 unchanged, and a group target still ripples as F's did (tst_editregistry). tst_fclipboard, tst_targeting, tst_seamexample and the op check pass unchanged

Layout F1: TimelineInspector hosts the sections registered with registerInspectorSection inside its Flickable, between Transform and Animate in web order, and passes timelineModel, gestures and controller to each; TransitionSection registers there and has no nt-panel marker

With TimelineEditor.qml loaded offscreen at 1280x800 and a clip after another selected, the Transition section scrolls into the Inspector viewport, has a model, and choosing Crossfade adds one undo entry (tst_inspectorsections). Red: on the old files the section lies outside the window
tst_transitions and the D1 Inspector tests pass unchanged

Data-safety F1: on start the controller moves a recovery or conflict copy from an earlier session aside, a save of this session never deletes it, and SaveBanners offers it with Restore and Discard; Restore applies it as one undo entry through the restoreDocument edit and autosave saves it, Discard deletes it

tst_autosave: a recovery copy from an earlier controller survives a clean save of a new one (red on the old controller), a second conflict does not overwrite the first session's copy, Restore and Discard behave as stated, and every existing case passes

packages.title: External sync
exit: resource_change reaches the editor: a script proves on a scratch server that an MCP timeline edit emits resource_change for that sequence (red: report a server-side blocker and use a CLI or tRPC write as the trigger)

Clean editor adopts: with no unsaved edits an external write appears in the open editor (model and rendered state), only when the server copy is newer than the held updatedAt, and undo does not revert the external edit

Dirty editor merges: with unsaved local edits an external write is merged as timelineExternalMerge does; the merge conformance suite gives the web merge result on fixtures covering disjoint edits, same-clip edits, deletes, adds, track changes and conflicts
Autosave survives a conflict (B35): a save conflict merges the server copy and continues saving; no edit is left only in memory; the conflict copy rule matches the web
Reconnect: after the WebSocket drops and reconnects with the web backoff, the editor fetches once to catch missed changes; auth matches ServerClient (Bearer for remote servers)

End to end, headless: the native editor opens a timeline from a scratch server; an MCP edit appears within 2 s; the next native save succeeds without conflict; with a pending local edit both changes survive
Unchanged otherwise: the full 6e checks pass; the sanitize ctest has no report outside tools/sanitizers/baseline.md

packages.title: Server identity before a write
exit: Closes m5b F4 (docs/reviews/round3-save.md): the identity proof covers the connection that carries the write, and a copied /ready answer does not pass it

check-server-identity.mjs swaps the scratch server for a recording listener during --wait-before-write. The listener receives no byte of the POST, and the client exits 1 with WRONG_SERVER or a connection error and does not retry. With only the flag added and the old mutate, the check fails
A listener that replays headers copied from a real scratch server /ready answer gets no write (tst_serveridentity and the check script)

ServerClient::upload takes the same proof: a listener that replaces the server after the identity check receives no byte of the multipart body, and an upload to the scratch server still stores the asset (tst_serveridentity)
mutate and upload keep the signatures S1 gave them, so merged A and B need no change
scratch-safety.test.mjs: mutate and upload send no body to a replacement listener
A save against the scratch server still writes, and timeline.get returns the edit. tst_autosave and tst_serverclient pass
A client with no expected instance sends one request (mutateWithoutAnExpectationSendsDirectly)
No check sends a request to port 7777
